summary.text: Anthony Daniels is a Democratic state representative from Alabama House District 53 who took office in November 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He began serving as House Minority Leader in February 2017, and his professional experience includes teaching elementary school and co-owning a dental practice.

paragraphs.text: Daniels' professional experience includes teaching elementary school and co-owning a dental practice.
He assumed office in the Alabama House on November 5, 2014, succeeding Anthony Johnson.
Daniels began serving as Alabama House of Representatives Minority Leader on February 8, 2017.
In the 2025-2026 session Daniels was assigned to the House Education Policy Committee, the House Rules Committee, the Madison County Legislation Committee and the Ways and Means Education Committee.
